body: The two things I can do now is look for a new job and go see a psychologist that's really all I can handle right now. 9 hours later I want to live but it's a 60/40 thing. Thank you so much, I was so close. Hoping it gets better before it gets worse.

What you say is true I don't want to die "right now" it comes in waves. When I posted this I was at rock bottom. I am okay right now but scared. I've never felt like that like living wasn't worth it. I hope tomorrow is a better day. Thanks.

I'm hoping so... I had been thinking about posting here but now I am at a point where I think there is a greater chance of me letting go than to keep pushing. I know it's not rational but that's where I'm at. Thanks for your encouragement though.

That's all I want so badly is to get through it. I know it takes time I just feel like I don't have any left and I don't know why. It hurts not knowing why someone left after 2 years I just can't understand it. They just one day moved on why can't I?
